extraction_notes: [text-pass] The article focuses on the decomposition behavior of Ag0.9Sb1.1Te2.1 rather than reporting new thermoelectric performance data for various dopants. The only explicit numerical thermoelectric values provided are for zT at 600 K under different measurement rates in the supplementary discussion section. [figure-pass p1-5] The paper focuses on the decomposition behavior of Ag0.9Sb1.1Te2.1. Figure 2e provides room-temperature electrical conductivity and Seebeck coefficient data for samples aged at different temperatures. No other temperature-dependent thermoelectric property plots were found. [figure-pass p6-8] The provided pages contain information about the phase stability and decomposition behavior of Ag0.9Sb1.1Te2.1, including TTT diagrams and heat flow curves. However, there are no plots or tables showing thermoelectric properties (Seebeck coefficient, electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, power factor, or ZT) as a function of temperature for any AgSbTe2-family compounds.
